methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: cfdclump.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> int
methods.description: Remove from the given group from the CFD clump. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is an integer which is the first slot in which the group name was found or -1 if not found.

methods.description: Get a tuple of group names assigned to this CFD clump.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: cfdclump.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the CFD clump is part of a given group. All group slots are searched.
